title: A timed-out request that ignores abort is recorded after the grace period and the campaign starts the next run
text: A timed-out request that ignores abort is recorded after the grace period and the campaign starts the next run while it remains in flight. This permits overlapping model calls, corrupting run isolation/cost evidence and amplifying external requests. Stop the campaign or isolate/terminate the timed-out worker before advancing.
rationale: Real defect: timed-out request could overlap the next run. Fixed in 51340557 (fix(#105): stop the campaign when a timed-out request is still in flight), the direct child of the reviewed head 43507161, which adds the requested loop break. Its sibling timeout finding was also fixed. Rationale corrected after a Codex comment on #138. Verdict drafted by the assistant and accepted by LH without per-record review (delegated 2026-09-30).
